name: Bennett
title: The Great Spill Count
blurb: Bennett is too little for a real challenge, so he got the one he's already training for: spilling things. Every cup, glass, and bowl he tips over between now and the end of the year gets counted. There is no goal. There is only the tally.

log.note: Milk at dinner. Bennett didn't cry over it, but I did.
A glass of water. The whole glass. All while helping mom do dishes.
Salted caramel syrup. The smell is great. Jordyn would have preferred it in her coffee.
A lid while helping with the dishes.
A bowl while helping with the dishes.
A cup while helping with the dishes. Should we be letting him help with these any more??? 🫠
The Cheerios he made us get him after he opted not to eat dinner.
The rest of the Cheerios he didn't spill the first time literally after the first round was cleaned up.

milestones.title: First Spill
milestones.desc: The first one of the challenge.
